subtitle: Study groups, teams and mentors — safe and moderated
rule1: Groups only — there are no private messages.
rule2: Phone numbers, emails, addresses and social media are removed automatically.
rule3: Mean, sexual or bullying posts are blocked. Tap Report on anything that feels wrong.
rule4: School spaces need a code from your teacher, school or parent.
rule5: Never agree to meet someone from here alone. Tell a trusted adult if anything feels off.
locked: People is turned off by your parent or guardian.
joinToPost: To post, join your school group with the code from your teacher. You can still read open groups.
nicknameHelp: Shown next to your posts. Use a nickname, not your full name.
clubsEmpty: Join your school group to see your school's clubs.
planNotFound: No plan found with that code.
planHelp: A friend can share their plan with you. Type the 6-letter code they give you.
noCheers: No cheers yet. Be the first!
writeRide: Offer or ask for a ride
postPlaceholder: Be kind and helpful. Don't share personal info.
rideHelp: Meet at the school, never at a home. Personal info is removed.
reported: Thanks — our team will look at it. Posts with several reports are hidden.
removedInfo: We removed some personal info (like phone numbers or social media) to keep you safe.
blocked: This post wasn't shared. Please keep posts kind and school-appropriate.
tooMany: You've posted a lot today. Try again tomorrow.
notAllowed: You can't post here. School spaces need the right code.
lockedGroup: This group needs a school code. Join on the Me tab.
empty: No posts yet. Start the conversation!
mentorNote: Only verified mentors (with a mentor code) can answer here.
alumniNote: Stories are posted by school staff after checking with the graduate.
shareHelp: Friends can follow your plan with a code and send you cheers. Only the goal and steps are shared — not your name.
buddyHelp: Let classmates in your school group know you're going. Only your nickname is shown.
buddyNone: No classmates have said they're going yet.
buddyJoin: Join your school group to see which classmates are going.
